meta.name: dialogue-audio
meta.description: Multi-speaker dialogue audio creation with ElevenLabs and Dia TTS. Covers speaker tags, emotion control, pacing, conversation flow, and post-production. Use for: podcasts, audiobooks, explainers, character dialogue, conversational content. Triggers: dialogue audio, multi speaker, conversation audio, dia tts, two speakers, podcast audio, character voices, voice acting, dialogue generation, conversation tts, multi voice, speaker tags, dialogue recording, elevenlabs dialogue, eleven labs conversation

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多角色对话生成播客、有声书和配音内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用AI生成多说话人对话音频，用于播客、有声书或教学解说。
copy.tagline_en: Generate multi-speaker dialogue audio for podcasts, audiobooks, and voiceovers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create multi-speaker dialogue audio for podcasts, audiobooks, or explainers.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能使用 Dia TTS 生成双人对话音频，支持说话人标签、情感控制、语速调节和后期处理。
howto.when: 当你要求生成多说话人对话音频，或提到“对话音频”、“双人对话”、“播客音频”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一段双人对话音频，讨论新功能。
say.note: Claude 会调用 Dia TTS 生成对话音频。

say.text: 用 [S1] 和 [S2] 标签写一段采访对话并生成音频。
say.note: Claude 会按标签分配两个声音。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate two-speaker dialogue audio using Dia TTS, supporting speaker tags, emotion control, pacing, and post-production.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for multi-speaker dialogue audio or mention keywords like "dialogue audio", "multi speaker", "podcast audio", etc.

say_en.text: Generate a two-speaker dialogue audio discussing the new feature.
say_en.note: Claude will call Dia TTS to generate the audio.

say_en.text: Write an interview dialogue with [S1] and [S2] tags and generate audio.
say_en.note: Claude will assign two voices based on tags.
